title: Modality-Guided Mixture of Structured Experts with Entropy-Triggered Routing for Multimodal Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2602.20723v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal recommenders combine collaborative behavior with visual and textual item evidence, whose usefulness varies across user-item interactions. Independently trained source-specific diagnostic probes partition held-out interactions into behavior-, appearance-, semantics-, and mixed-evidence regimes across five benchmarks, within which capacity-matched fixed fusion rules exhibit systematic regime-dependent performance crossovers. This diagnostic observation motivates MAGNET, a multimodal graph recommender with two core mechanisms. translated_title: 面向多模态推荐的模态引导结构化专家混合与熵触发路由
translated_abstract: 多模态推荐系统将协同行为与物品的视觉、文本证据相结合，而这些证据在不同用户-物品交互中的有用程度各不相同。通过独立训练的特定来源诊断探针，在五个基准数据集上将留出的交互划分为行为证据、外观证据、语义证据和混合证据四种情境，在这些情境内，容量匹配的固定融合规则表现出系统性的、依赖于情境的性能交叉现象。这一诊断观察启发了MAGNET——一个具有两个核心机制的多模态图推荐模型。第一，一个经过校准的专家库按锚定来源（行为、外观或语义）和融合家族（主导型、平衡型或互补型）组织可训练专家，同时由一个基于交互条件的路由器利用全部三种证据来源选择稀疏的专家组合。第二，一个熵触发、覆盖率感知的渐进式调度将群体层面的路由质量覆盖率与每实例层面的决策解耦……
tldr: 提出MAGNET多模态图推荐模型，通过按证据来源与融合策略组织的校准专家库、交互条件化稀疏路由以及熵触发覆盖率感知的渐进调度，自适应地为不同交互情境选择最合适的模态融合策略。
en_tdlr: MAGNET is a multimodal graph recommender that combines a calibrated expert bank organized by evidence source and fusion family, an interaction-conditioned sparse router, and an entropy-triggered coverage-aware progressive schedule to adaptively select modality fusion strategies for varying interaction regimes.
